label: Crawford 1967 LDE delay distribution (Stanford)
source: Crawford, F.W., Sears, D.M., Bruce, R.L. (1970). 'Possible observations and mechanism of very long delayed radio echoes.' JGR 75(34), 7326–7332. Vidmar, R.J. & Crawford, F.W. (1985). 'Long-delayed radio echoes: Mechanisms and observations.' JGR 90(A2), 1523–1530.
citation: Crawford et al. (1970) JGR 75 7326; Vidmar & Crawford (1985) JGR 90 1523.
provenance_note: Histogram estimated from qualitative description in Faizullin (2010): 'Delays with 2 and 8 seconds were the most frequent.' Sears 1974 PhD thesis 'Long Delayed Radio Echoes' (DTIC ADA003070) may contain tabulated values; not accessed. Counts approximate.
caveat: Historical LDE series (1928–1929) with delays up to 3.5 min were NOT reproduced. Only delays ≤40 s observed. Rate shift and time contraction noted relative to impulse spacing.
